To:  Chair Lawrence and Members of the Malibu Arts Commission

Approved by:  Kristin Riesgo , Community Services Director

Date prepared:  April 18, 2024  Meeting date: April 23, 2024

Subject:  Malibu Nights Event Proposal

RECOMMENDED ACTION : 1) Review the Malibu Nights, a Music, Art, and Food Walk
proposal prepared by Vice Chair Julia Holland and Commissioner Barry Haldeman; and
2) Provide feedback to staff.

DISCUSSION: At the February 27, 2024 Regular meeting, the Commission received an
event proposal from Vice Chair Holland and Commissioner Haldeman requesting the
Commission to review options to host Malibu Nights, a Music, Art, and Food Walk at
various locations in Malibu.

The proposed event includes a variety of musical performances, art displays, and food
options in connection with local restaurants. Locations include the shopping centers at
Cross Creek Road , the Lumberyard, Whole Foods, and Malibu Colony Plaza. Additional
elements include security, a shuttle service, staffing, and volunteers (Attachment 1).

The event requires permitting through the Planning Department, insurance, and
agreements between the City and local shopping centers.

The Commission may review the proposal and provide feedback to staff on the event
structure. Depending on the Commission's recommendation, staff would return with
information regarding the City's permitting requirements, potential budget, and
necessary agreements.

ATTACHMENTS : Malibu Nights Music and Food Walk Proposal

  Page 1 of 1
  Agenda Item# 5.B.
   Malibu Nights
  Music Art & Food Walk
  Living Document
  Created by Julia Holland, Barry Haldeman
  Malibu Arts Commission

WHAT IS IT?

Modeled after the Nuit Blanche even in Paris in June:

  The Nuit Blanche event in Paris invites you to see the city in a different way, at
  night, lit by moonlight, neons and other lights. In June, in all parts of the city, artists
  will be proposing installations, exhibitions, concerts, performances, staged scene
  sets and creations that explore all facets of contemporary art and offer a new view
  of the city. Public transport stays open all night so that spectators can design their
  own route among the dozens of avant-garde projects of international artists. The
  Nuit Blanche was first organized in 2002, and, like the Fete de la Musique, it has
  spread around the world to other cities in France and other European capitals, a
  proof of its popularity and relevance today.

This would be an annual event similar to the Malibu Chili Cook Off but much more
low-key. There would be a variety of musical performances, or even buskers that would
perform in each area.

Restaurants would be open and potentially also bring their dining outside, maybe with a
limited appetizer menu and drinks so people would be encouraged to go from place to
place.

Art galleries would be open as well as retail outlets.

Possible outside art exhibits with the Malibu Arts Association and others.

Musical Groups would play at selective locations with a range of music to add to the
festive nature.

Possible name: "Malibu at Night" or "Malibu Night"

WHO WOULD PARTICIPATE?

  ATTACHMENT I
 All retail stores, galleries and restaurants in Malibu's Cross Creek, Lumberyard, Whole
Foods and Ralphs centers.

WHEN?

It would be scheduled for September or October or possibly late June to not conflict with
the Chamber of Commerce Art Festival or the B&GC Chili Cook Off.

It would take place one Saturday evening and would stay open until 11 PM

SECURITY

Security would be necessary

PARKING AND SHUTTLE
A general parking area would be encouraged and a shuttle would run between the
areas in Central Malibu.

PARTNERSHIPS
The City of Malibu would partner with the Chamber of Commerce and funding would be
secured by sponsors for the evening.

STAFFING
A coordinating team would need to be hired and volunteers secured to make the event
happen.

PERMITS
We would need to approach the City for permits for the event.

  ATTACHMENT I
 PUBLICITY
We would publicize it as a locals night, but know that the reach could be much farther.
Just as the Malibu Chili Cook Off "Locals" night attracts many outsiders. We would ask
the participating restaurants, galleries, restaurants and musicians to help publicize the
event.

ORDINANCES
We would need to get permits from the City.
We could require that the music be acoustic only and the sound level be kept to a
certain level.

  ATTACHMENT I

  Commissioner Haldeman stated he attended the Los Angeles Art Show, where an

  Community Services Director Riesgo stated that the topic was unrelated to the item
  up for discussion.

  Commissioner Haldeman stated that the Malibu Nights event would require the
  involvement of businesses, obtaining a Temporary Use Permit, and a partnership
  with the Chamber of Commerce. He stated that the event should not be at Malibu
  Bluffs Park because the concept included people shopping, visiting, and supporting

  Commissioner Cherin stated that the concept had been discussed before but had
  never come to fruition.

  Commissioner Haldeman stated that a similar event occurred in Culver City, and
